theorem: For the channel E(rho)=sum_i <i|rho|i> tau_i and maximally mixed reference input, optimizing entanglement fidelity over every CPTP recovery is equivalent to binary discrimination of tau_0 and tau_1. The Helstrom measurement followed by preparation of |i> attains F_e=(1+||tau_0-tau_1||_1/2)/4. The dual Helstrom operator proves global optimality. The proof is valid for arbitrary qubit outputs, not only the ST266 rational example.
validity_class: all binary qubit density outputs; rational entries give an exact algebraic value
